operations.expected: Named constants on the summed bus: TARGET_LUFS_I -18, TARGET_TP_DBTP -1, BED_ALIVE_ST_LUFS -20.5, BLOOM_ST_LUFS -14, VOICE_ST_LUFS -16, SFX_TRANSIENT_HEADROOM_DB 3.5, UI_LUFS -22. The bed sits 2 to 3 LU under target so world and player transients complete it rather than fight it, which is the condition for the duck matrix to stay subtle. The mastering tail, in SHIPPED order, is the Stage 1 glue (GLUE_THRESH_DB -18, GLUE_RATIO 2.5, knee 12, unity static gain), then the safety compressor, which is a safety device and not a programme compressor (SAFETY_THRESH_DB -6, SAFETY_RATIO 20, SAFETY_KNEE_DB 0 to 3, SAFETY_ATTACK_S at most 0.003, SAFETY_RELEASE_S 0.1), then the SFX category buses JOIN at the master output, then the limiter, then the 4x-oversampled ceiling, then a unity route: music alone passes glue and safety; the summed music-plus-SFX programme passes the limiter and the ceiling, because only a post-join stage can protect the sum every true-peak measurement is taken on. The limiter is a BOUNDED CEILING WITH MEASURED MARGIN, not a true-peak guarantee: the shaper y = x/(1+|x/c|^6)^(1/6) has its asymptote at c, so sample peaks are mathematically bounded below TARGET_TP_DBTP and the only residual is the 4x resampler's reconstruction, measured under 0.01 dB with a margin of at least 0.5 dB at +12 dBFS (worst -1.58 dBTP on a +12 dBFS burst, -4.92 dBTP worst on real shipped material). No AudioWorklet is warranted; the CEILING_DBTP -1.5 escape hatch stays documented. No dynamic and no hidden gain exists anywhere: every DynamicsCompressor's baked makeup is cancelled by a named, measured trim. Exactly one static, named, tested reference gain, TAIL_REFERENCE_GAIN_DB, which is +1.99 dB against a makeup-free chain and is level-preserving rather than level-raising because it reproduces the gain every Stage 1 term was measured through, preserves the pre-Stage-2 level architecture; it may only be changed by an owner re-level decision, and no other positive static gain may exist anywhere in the chain. UI and voice bypass the submerge filter because the institution is not underwater. Under a story lead the music duck column is capped at -3 dB. Stage 2 baseline status: the voice bus and its -9 dB duck row, lifecycleCue category, station snapshot and roomPresetId were inert plumbing and were not credited by its audition. Stage 4/6 may bind only their contracted live drivers, each requiring current source-bound proof. Station activation remains deferred until original zero-audio station proof and a separately signed integration amendment. A source hook is not activation or acceptance evidence. Provisional single Stage5 arrangement trial after reconciliation: BLOOM_RAIL_DB10→10.4 and BLOOM_LIFT_SUSTAIN.15→.10 only. Retain two-bar crest, BUILD/section/timing geometry, harmony/motif/layer ownership, other family rails, all slews, protected MOODS/bed-floor/story-envelope gains and refusal bloomBudget0/plateau-or-fall. This changes only the expressly commissioned amplitude envelope, also affecting BUILD; it is not a three-second-only change. Full/lean four210s-bed pre-tail/shared-tail I/S/TP/composedSpread/smoothness, original fingerprints≤2LSB, protected floors/refusals and fresh crash-over-measured-BLOOM/voice WAVs plus audition remain required. These are proposed trial settings, not final sound approval. Stress arrangement/window/density remedies remain undecided pending the40 matched real renders, with every original failed I target retained.

operations.expected: Stage 2: five stress scripts through the combined render (shipCrash over BLOOM, a 40-node mining burst, oxygen pulses under dive, terminal typing over a story lead, jetpack loop plus splash) each hold true peak at or below -1 dBTP. Their integrated loudness against the -18 plus or minus 1.5 LU target is RECORDED at Stage 2, not failed: the measured -20.4 to -21.7 LU is the architecture question, not a mix defect, because the -18 sum presumes SFX energy the shipped recipes (0.012 to 0.09 linear) do not yet carry, and the target is re-asserted at Stage 4 under a stated SFX density per stress script (HD-08(3)). Measured duck depth matches the duck matrix within 1 dB, including -6 dB on music inside the row's attack time from the audible impact of a ship crash (from 0 dB today); the attack is measured onset-adjusted, subtracting the shared SFX join latency LATENCY_COMP_SFX_PATH_S from the impact onset, and with a bin tolerance of at least 10 ms, so a 5 ms-bin artefact can neither fail nor pass the term by itself. Steady-state AudioParam writes are RECORDED at Stage 2, not failed: 2276 per second before and 590.4 per second after (setTargetAtTime 528 per second, of which scoreEngine.applyRails contributes about 468, plus cancelAndHoldAtTime 60 per second); the under-60-per-second target is a Stage 3 acceptance term, not a Stage 2 one. mining-metronome-probe.mjs is re-run and its NAMED FIELDS are compared field by field rather than asserted 'unchanged', which is literally false and correctly so: suppressed-per-3s falls from 5 to 0 because the structural queue now absorbs what the rate limiter used to, the loop guard never engages and remains untouched as the backstop, and activeMineSeconds stays 0 and cycles stays 0 both before and after, so the probe's own PASS criterion is unmet on both sides because the sandbox-no-op instrument cannot engage mining - a pre-existing Stage 0 tooling defect owned by Integration, closed before Stage 4, and not a term of this stage. BLOOM short-term maximum is DEFERRED TO STAGE 5, not waived and not retargeted (HD-08(2)): the measured Stage 2 value is -17.90 LU, the subtract-only makeup-free tail's whole available authority is 0.21 LU, and a -14 plus or minus 1 LU window is an arrangement property rather than a tail property, so it is re-asserted as a Stage 5 BLOOM-only arrangement rail. Stage 2 publishes the named composedSpread field - pre-tail short-term maximum minus integrated per excerpt, measured 2.5 LU against the 6.5 LU the window requires - as the evidence that the miss is compositional. The bed at alive still measures -20.5 plus or minus 1 LU integrated alone, and no stage may open the window by re-levelling that bed. To make that window possible Stage 2 is authorised, as a contracted change to main/src/audio/audioCore.ts, to retune the safety compressor from a programme squash into a true safety device behind the new true-peak limiter: named constants SAFETY_THRESH_DB -6, SAFETY_RATIO 20, SAFETY_KNEE_DB 3 (any value from 0 to 3 is permitted), SAFETY_ATTACK_S at most 0.003, SAFETY_RELEASE_S 0.1, with the limiter at TARGET_TP_DBTP -1 owning protection and the safety compressor acting only above it; Chrome's baked makeup gain for the new curve is cancelled by a named SAFETY_MAKEUP_COMP_DB trim measured exactly as GLUE_MAKEUP_COMP_DB is (a -30 dBFS probe tone through the offline chain with and without the stage), so the whole mastering tail keeps its pre-Stage-2 static gain at bare and colour level within 0.1 dB. No dynamic and no hidden gain exists anywhere: every DynamicsCompressor's baked makeup is cancelled by a named, measured trim. Exactly one static, named, tested reference gain, TAIL_REFERENCE_GAIN_DB, which is +1.99 dB against a makeup-free chain and is level-preserving rather than level-raising because it reproduces the gain every Stage 1 term was measured through, preserves the pre-Stage-2 level architecture; it may only be changed by an owner re-level decision, and no other positive static gain may exist anywhere in the chain. Because bare peaks at -25 dBTP sat inside the old 30 dB knee, the bare and colour era hashes are re-baselined ONCE at Stage 2 with before/after inaudibility evidence rendered through the old tail and the new tail: (a) a pre-tail tap of bare-bed, colour-bed and crawl-to-ch1-fixed is fingerprint identical with every 16-bit sample delta at or under 2 LSB, proving the change is confined to the tail; (b) through the tail the same three renders hold integrated loudness within 0.3 LU, short-term loudness within 1 LU at every 3 s window and true peak within 0.5 dB of the old tail; (c) the owner (or the delegated production lead) A/Bs the bare and colour renders at the Stage 2 audition and hears no change; the new renders are then pinned as the bare-era before hash for Stage 3 onward. A story-floor check renders the ch4-defy, refused and seam-ebb hand-back excerpts through the old and new tails and holds each within 0.25 LU. Stage 2 measures the finished tail with measureTailLatencyS on the tail itself and publishes THREE named constants for Stage 3: LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_PATH_S (music onset through glue, safety, both shapers and the limiter), LATENCY_COMP_SFX_PATH_S (SFX join through the limiter) and their difference LATENCY_COMP_MUSIC_VS_SFX_S. Each is published PER CONTEXT SAMPLE RATE as a table keyed by 44100 and 48000 (and any rate the soak mirror can render), every entry measured at its own rate in an OfflineAudioContext of that rate and none derived from another rate by seconds or by samples, and every entry re-measured by audio:check each run within LATENCY_COMP_TOLERANCE_S 0.5 ms. The measured 44.1 kHz entries are 25.215 ms, 10.340 ms and 14.875 ms (0.89 frame); the 48 kHz entries are measured, not modelled, and the dissent recorded as D-2 stands until that render exists. At arming the derivation selects the entry whose key equals ctx.sampleRate, else the nearest key, and the capture overlay names the key used.
